messages:
Ashley: heads-up — Acme's trial POC is seeing intermittent 429s during a bulk upload test. Happened ~45s into the run. log link (redacted): https://acme-demo.logs/recent

Samir: can you share the sample error + response headers? 429 could be per-route RPM or token-rate throttling.

Ashley: customer pasted this: 
Customer: \"{\"error\":\"Too many requests\",\"status\":429}\"
Headers: x-ratelimit-limit: 60, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 13

Miguel (oncall): default /v1/generate = 60 rpm short window. Were they running parallel workers or single stream?

Ashley: parallel staging agents — 8 workers on their side, each ~1 req/s, ~1 minute run. Also mentioned \"token budget\" concerns since payloads average ~1200 tokens.

Jia: two possible limits here: request-count per-route and token throughput. Rough calc: 8 workers * 60s * ~1 r/s = ~480 requests in that window, so per-route 60 rpm will definitely cap them before token budget. What's org quota show?

rate-limiter-bot: Quota snapshot for org \"acme-corp\":
- monthly_token_budget: 5,000,000 tokens
- tokens_used_month_to_date: 1,100,432
- per_minute_token_rate_limit: 20000 tokens/min
- per_route_requests_per_minute (default /v1/generate): 60

Miguel (oncall): yep — per-route is the limiter. Sales wants a temporary raise while the POC runs. Requested: /v1/generate -> 120 rpm and 30000 tokens/min.

Samir: applying targeted bump now via CLI:
```
redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --rpm 120 --token-rate 30000 --note \"trial bump for Acme POC\"
```
Samir: done. Change q-97321. Propagating (~10s).

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org \"acme-corp\" (change q-97321). New per-route rpm: 120. New token_rate_limit: 30000 tokens/min.

Ashley: told Acme to re-run test. They returned a short log: 
[2026-04-19T15:42:03Z] POST /v1/generate 200 1180 tokens
[2026-04-19T15:42:04Z] POST /v1/generate 429 x-ratelimit-remaining:0

Miguel (oncall): that single 429 is probably due to window-edge race — some in-flight requests hit the old rate window before propagation. Recommend adding a short burst allowance for trials to smooth the edge.

Jia: propose burst_capacity=300 over 30s for this trial org. That will absorb the parallel startup. Also advise customers to add jitter/backoff on retry.

Samir: patching burst policy:
```
redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --burst_capacity 300 --burst_window 30
```
Samir: applied (q-97322).

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated for org \"acme-corp\" (q-97322). burst_capacity: 300, burst_window: 30s.

Ashley: Acme re-ran and reported \"errors dropped to near zero — huge improvement\" :tada:

Miguel (oncall): leaving a quick SRE note: for sales POCs with parallel workers start with rpm=120-200, token-rate=25k-50k tokens/min, burst_capacity=200-400 per 30s window. Add guidance on client-side exponential backoff with jitter to avoid synchronized retries.

Jia: filing internal ticket INF-4521 to add a templated workflow for sales quota bumps (includes audit note + auto-expiry).

Samir: audit: changes q-97321, q-97322 recorded; policy auto-expiry in 7 days unless extended by owner.

Ashley: I will follow up if Acme asks to keep it longer. Marking POC stage as resolved from our side, will monitor. Thanks all <3

Miguel (oncall): monitoring for 2 hours; will alert if error rate rises.

rate-limiter-bot: Monitoring: org \"acme-corp\" 1-min error rate decreased from 18% -> 1.2%.
